name: After recital B
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: Bc. whereas even though Muslim migrants are often told that their discrimination is based on their lack of integration, Muslims with a university degree actually face more racism on average, according to the FRA; whereas 49 % of highly educated Muslims report that they felt discriminated; whereas European Muslims are often labelled as perpetrators of violence and terrorism, they are also targets of far-right extremism; whereas 4 % of Muslims who experienced violent attacks, identified members of the extremist right-wing groups as the perpetrators, according to the FRA;
